items.description: Lives for a good fight. Happy after victories, ashamed when the ship runs.
Prefers to live. Dislikes every fight; relieved when you talk your way out.
Here to see the galaxy. Ruins, lore and new systems lift them; long dull stretches wear on them.
In it for the money. Big sales and salvage please them; shakedowns do not bother them.
Has a code. Unprovoked attacks and shakedowns upset them; mercy pleases them.
Needs people. Loves shore leave, takes a crewmate's death hardest, hates long voyages.
Hard to move either way. Every morale change is halved.
